candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care — Collaboration with Multidisciplinary Team / Continuity of Care: identify significant information to report; communicate with team; utilize resources to promote quality client care
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — team communication and resource coordination
candidate.educational_objective: Use preoperative briefings to identify anticipated changes in the surgical plan and close resource gaps before the procedure begins, especially when conversion to an open procedure is possible.

options.A: Begin the procedure because conversion can be discussed only if it actually becomes necessary
options.B: Use the briefing to communicate the resource gap and ensure required open-procedure equipment is available before the case begins
options.C: Wait until conversion is requested, then leave the room to locate the needed equipment
options.D: Omit the concern from the briefing because equipment availability is unrelated to team communication

candidate.rationale: AORN team-communication guidance identifies briefings as a tool for creating a shared mental model and situational awareness. AORN minimally invasive surgery guidance specifically notes that discussing possible conversion to an open procedure during the preoperative briefing allows the team to identify and gather needed resources in advance and anticipate intraoperative changes. Starting without required resources or waiting until an urgent conversion is underway creates avoidable delay and risk.
candidate.source_claim_supported: AORN supports preoperative briefing to create shared situational awareness and specifically recommends discussing possible open conversion so the team can identify and gather resources in advance.
candidate.source_document_title: Revised Guideline for Team Communication; Updates to the Guideline for Minimally Invasive Surgery
candidate.source_locator: Team Communication — briefings promote a shared mental model and situational awareness; Minimally Invasive Surgery, Communication/Key Takeaway — discuss potential conversion to open procedure during preoperative briefing to identify and gather resources in advance
candidate.source_version_date: Team Communication revision published 2024-07-09; current in AORN Guidelines for Perioperative Practice, 2026 Edition
candidate.stem: During the preoperative team briefing for a planned minimally invasive procedure, the surgeon states that conversion to an open procedure may be necessary. The circulating nurse realizes that the open-procedure instrument set is not immediately available. What is the best action?
